lean.statement:
theorem inverse_mate_isIso_of_support
    {A B D E : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category D] [Category E]
    {L : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} {l : D ⥤ E} {r : E ⥤ D}
    (a : L ⊣ R) (b : l ⊣ r) (F : A ⥤ D) (G : B ⥤ E)
    (e : R ⋙ F ≅ G ⋙ r) [IsIso a.unit]
    (hc : ∀ M, IsIso (b.counit.app (G.obj (L.obj M)))) :
    IsIso ((mateEquiv a b).symm (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ e.hom)).natTrans

title: Invertibility of an inverse mate on supported objects
statement: Let a : L ⊣ R and b : l ⊣ r be adjunctions between arbitrary categories. Let F,G be connecting functors and e : R ⋙ F ≅ G ⋙ r. If a.unit is invertible and b.counit at G(L(M)) is invertible for every M, then the inverse mate of e.hom is invertible.

proof.text: Expand the component of the inverse mate as identities, images of the source unit, the isomorphism e, and the target counit. All factors are invertible by the hypotheses. Invertibility of every component makes the natural transformation invertible.
